limits_and_scope: Timings are medians of three per-repetition rank maxima; includes collective waiting.
Counters are observed logical directory calls and checked broadcasts, not measured network bytes or an MPI profiler.
The source/resource snapshot and installed native package remain immutable during each measurement.
The optimized diagnostic profile differs from the earlier capacity profile; historical elapsed times are not a controlled speedup comparison.
Resource-only loading retains coefficient, angle, integrity, ownership and permutation checks; portable replay remains separately admitted.
No strict sparse-capacity closure or macOS validation is established by these probes.
Each Cray paired comparison uses the same frozen executable, profile and immutable input; three repetitions alternate mode order.

The paired native probe starts from the same plus state, compares every forward-state hash per rank, and checks every local roundtrip coordinate; broader arbitrary-state equivalence is covered separately by unitary tests.
The frozen paired source predates native communication-buffer reuse and cannot validate that later change.
